name: ignore-read-count
title: Ignoring read count writes stale bytes
fix_goal: Use the byte count returned by p101_read when deciding how much data is valid.
fix_steps: Find the p101_read call and save its return value.
Find the p101_write call that writes sizeof(buffer).
Write exactly the number of bytes returned by p101_read.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the stale-buffer lab is fixed.
lesson: A buffer's capacity is not the number of valid bytes in it; writing capacity can leak stale data.
